name: zsnd_snapshot_payload_capture
description: zSndPlayHandleSnapshotPayload::CaptureFromPlayHandle captures backend play-handle state into a pause/resume snapshot payload.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?CaptureFromPlayHandle@zSndPlayHandleSnapshotPayload@@QAIXPAUzSndPlayHandle@@@Z at 0x4a0300 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after 4 COFF relocation bytes were masked; Binary Ninja body is 120 bytes, the VC object symbol is 128 bytes with 8 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and evidence is under build/vc5-verify/zsnd_snapshot_payload_capture/verify.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a0300 validates the non-backend early return before zero-fill, the 0x28-byte payload memset, playHandle and ownerSample capture, backend 0/1 volumeScaleRaw capture from ownerSample->primaryVoice.gainScaled, optional flags bit 0, and worldPos/velocityOrDir copies when playHandle->hasWorldPos is nonzero.

The focused native smoke verifies early return preserves the destination payload, DirectSound and A3D backend volume capture, unsupported-backend zero-volume behavior, no-world-position zeroed payload fields, and world/velocity copying.
The active-samples snapshot smoke verifies the helper in its production list-building context for DirectSound and A3D primary and duplicate handles.
